problem: Aiden meeting room still displayed awkward strategy receipt formatting and silently used snapshot mode even when the owner asked it to search the web.
implemented: Replaced fragile strategy receipt parsing with ordered receipt-label parsing.
Split Top market-first routes into separate owner-readable bullets.
Prevented No-new-wheel decision from swallowing CZL Rt+1 and later fields.
Added snapshot freshness warning when provider mode is dated_public_read_evidence_snapshot.
Added server-side live public-read trigger detection for owner messages containing web/search/latest terms.
Added AIDEN_MESSENGER_ALLOW_LIVE_NETWORK environment flag for default live public-read mode.
Recorded allow_live_network status in server_runtime metadata.
owner_visible_change: Aiden strategy receipts now read less like logs, route candidates are separated, and web-search requests can trigger live public-read instead of hardcoded snapshot mode.
limitations: Live public-read depends on the underlying E108/E114 provider and local network availability.
The system still does not perform external outreach, posting, payment, or provider-side execution.
